reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 10 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: External-02 adds a clearly visible metal paperclip to the note's upper-right edge, which the source does not have and this round explicitly forbids. Remove the paperclip while retaining the two compact upper gray-mark rows and the rest of the card.
entries.positive_observation: The previous large gray stains are gone; the note now has two compact upper rows of small gray marks without large blotches and with largely blank lower paper. The yellow mascot retains the image-right pose/gaze, restrained closed-mouth half-smile, dark eyebrows, covered hair and absence of glasses, moustache or beard. The dark olive cap has gold piping/cord and two separated front emblems. The dark field-grey uniform, light shirt/collar edges, dark tie and small pale collar details remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque pale grey-beige backing remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The invented paperclip is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine eye/temple and collar-throat pixels, cap embroidery and exact note glyph shapes are unresolved at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those tiny unreadable shapes; the metal paperclip is unambiguous in the native crop.
